findings.rule: REVIEW.md Framework rules: 'Flag when the change has made CLAUDE.md outdated'; spec.md Design ('the one-line addition describing percent is proposed as a suggestion in the build-phase PR body')
findings.summary: CLAUDE.md's Layout line for sample_pkg/calc.py still says it exposes only 'add' and 'divide', now stale since percent() ships; intent.md's Affected users and systems and spec.md's Design both said the one-line addition would be proposed in the build-phase PR body for the owner, but PR #7's body contains no such proposed text, so there is no path left for the owner to close the gap.

percent(part, whole) scales part by 100 before dividing, so it overflows to inf for |part| above roughly 1.8e306 where the previous divide-then-scale order would not; unrealistic magnitude for a percent helper and already surfaced and accepted as not-Important in a prior adversarial review, restated here for completeness.
